cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Make Help Define Us
cards.instruction: Get their help, then use how it is offered to redefine what the relationship means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Help me finish this complaint as a colleague, please. Show me the edits before you send anything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've fixed the spelling and cut your angry last sentence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Restore the sentence. Correcting spelling isn't withdrawing the complaint; that's the part I need us to stand behind.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right. It's a good sentence. I'll send it on your behalf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put both our names under it instead. If we're colleagues, you're agreeing with that sentence, not just delivering it for me. Read it once more before we sign.
